findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. At line 51, an untrusted entry produces a refusal that never says a parent folder's trusted entry does not count, although the Done-when requires that warning in the refusal. It also suggests removing the entry: when the worktree's untrusted entry is the only exact entry, removal leaves Forge refusing the project. The exact-message assertion in tests/test_codex_setup.py:181-182 preserves this incomplete advice.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate. The repository review rule requires a change to a coordinator or worker step to update src/forge/templates/skill.md or the worker brief. This changed trust guard now refuses a Codex turn when only a parent folder is trusted, but the shipped guidance at src/forge/templates/skill.md:985-987 still says only to trust the project and consult doctor; neither shipped instruction states the new exact-entry requirement or that parent trust does not count.
